import json

# Premises stated in the passage, encoded as booleans.
premises = {
    "subjective_in_short_period": True,      # aesthetic judgment is subjective in the short term
    "contemporary_evaluations_diverge": True, # evaluations of contemporary works diverge greatly
    "subjectivity_fades_over_time": True,     # subjective element disappears over centuries
    "lasting_works_objectively_great": True,  # enduring works can fairly be called objectively great
}

# Each option: premises it needs, and whether the passage entails it.
options = {
    "A": {"needs": [], "entailed_by_passage": False,
          "note": "passage says nothing about how Da Vinci or Bach were evaluated in their lifetimes"},
    "B": {"needs": ["subjective_in_short_period", "contemporary_evaluations_diverge"],
          "entailed_by_passage": True,
          "note": "short-term subjectivity plus divergent contemporary evaluations make objective valuation hard"},
    "C": {"needs": ["subjectivity_fades_over_time"], "entailed_by_passage": False,
          "note": "passage says judgments converge over time, not that evaluations of one work differ sharply across eras"},
    "D": {"needs": [], "entailed_by_passage": False,
          "note": "passage makes greatness depend on lasting over centuries, not on critical unanimity"},
}

supported = [k for k, v in options.items()
             if v["entailed_by_passage"] and all(premises[p] for p in v["needs"])]

final_answer = supported[0] if len(supported) == 1 else "UNSUPPORTED"

evidence = {
    "supported_options": supported,
    "premises_used": [p for p in premises if premises[p]],
    "option_notes": {k: v["note"] for k, v in options.items()},
}

print(json.dumps({"final_answer": final_answer, "evidence": evidence}, separators=(",", ":")))
